halesowen.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of the Black Country
s1loc: Halesowen runs its live scene from the town centre. Cornbow Hall, the venue at the heart of the shopping precinct on Hagley Street, carries live music, comedy, tribute concerts and wrestling on its main-hall stage, while Halesowen Town Hall takes seated shows and function nights. Out at the green edges, the Grade I listed Leasowes, William Shenstone's eighteenth-century landscape, takes open-air gatherings, and each July the Halesowen Carnival and Music Festival joins the wider Black Country Festival to fill the town with stages and crowds.
